{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_float'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any suspicious revenue values (e.g., 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue_float'] == 999999.99
print(f"Found {qa_mask.sum()} QA orders with revenue = 999999.99")

# Display the rows
sales[qa_mask]"}
